title: Delivery: are we getting faster?
description: E02 (Release 1): p50/p90 delivery clocks kept separate per milestone and stage, last vs prior complete period, backlog age and overdue capacity, intake-cohort conversion and weekly volume, from the TTV ledger (capacity_intervals stage episodes, milestones, stage_objectives, assets). Lower bounds are shown as '≥' or excluded and counted; too little history says so. E07 (backlog flow) is Release 2.

panels.title: Now: unfinished work (open stage episodes)
Servers waiting in a stage now
panels.description:
Definition: servers with at least one open IDLE interval in a stage (DC, Redbull, POPAI or Serving): open stage episodes, counted once per server. The caption gives the idle GPUs in those episodes and the servers that are UNKNOWN now, which are not in this count.
Units: servers.
Filters: site, stage_owner.
Unknown vs zero: 'No ledger data yet' when the ledger has no open interval; UNKNOWN servers are never counted as waiting or as not waiting. Current state = intervals still open in the ledger (ended_at IS NULL), i.e. the latest engine scan; Queues and Evidence show its age.

targets.rawSql:
WITH cur AS (
  SELECT i.asset_id, i.stage, i.stage_entered_at AS entered_at,
         bool_or(i.stage_entered_lower_bound) OR i.stage_entered_at IS NULL AS lb,
         (array_agg(i.stage_owner ORDER BY i.started_at DESC, i.id DESC))[1] AS stage_owner,
         (array_agg(i.policy_version ORDER BY i.started_at DESC, i.id DESC))[1] AS policy_version,
         sum(i.gpus) AS gpus
  FROM capacity_intervals i
  JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id
  WHERE i.ended_at IS NULL AND i.category = 'IDLE' AND i.stage IS NOT NULL
    AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site))
    AND ('__all__' IN ($stage_owner) OR i.stage_owner IN ($stage_owner))
  GROUP BY i.asset_id, i.stage, i.stage_entered_at
), curx AS (
  SELECT c.*, extract(epoch FROM now() - c.entered_at)::float8 AS age_s,
         extract(epoch FROM o.objective)::float8 AS obj_s
  FROM cur c
  LEFT JOIN stage_objectives o ON o.stage = c.stage AND o.policy_version = c.policy_version
), unk AS (
  SELECT count(DISTINCT i.asset_id) AS servers
  FROM capacity_intervals i
  JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id
  WHERE i.ended_at IS NULL AND i.category = 'UNKNOWN' AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site))
)
SELECT now() AS time,
       CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals WHERE ended_at IS NULL) THEN 'no open interval in the ledger'
            ELSE coalesce((SELECT sum(gpus) FROM curx), 0) || ' GPUs · '
                 || (SELECT servers FROM unk) || ' UNKNOWN not counted' END AS metric,
       CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals WHERE ended_at IS NULL) THEN (SELECT count(DISTINCT asset_id) FROM curx) END AS value

panels.title: Overdue servers now
panels.description:
Definition: servers with an open stage episode older than its stage objective (age = now - stage_entered_at; objective from stage_objectives on the episode's (stage, policy_version)), the same rule as Queues' overdue.
Units: servers.
Filters: site, stage_owner.
Unknown vs zero: an episode whose clock began before observation counts once its minimum age passes the objective; until then it might already be overdue, so the value shows '≥' and the caption says how many such servers there are (purple). A stage with no objective is named in the caption. Green 0 only when every clock is known. Current state = intervals still open in the ledger (ended_at IS NULL), i.e. the latest engine scan; Queues and Evidence show its age.

panels.title: Oldest open stage episode
panels.description:
Definition: age (now - stage_entered_at) of the oldest open stage episode in scope; the caption names its stage owner and objective.
Units: days (hours under 1 day, said in the caption).
Filters: site, stage_owner.
Unknown vs zero: when any open episode in scope began before observation, the true oldest age can only be larger, so the value is a lower bound: '≥' and purple. Lower bounds: a stage clock with stage_entered_lower_bound began before observation, so its age is a minimum (≥). Current state = intervals still open in the ledger (ended_at IS NULL), i.e. the latest engine scan; Queues and Evidence show its age.

         bool_or(i.stage_entered_lower_bound) OR i.stage_entered_at IS NULL AS lb,
         (array_agg(i.stage_owner ORDER BY i.started_at DESC, i.id DESC))[1] AS stage_owner,

  FROM capacity_intervals i
  JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id
  WHERE i.ended_at IS NULL AND i.category = 'IDLE' AND i.stage IS NOT NULL
    AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site))
    AND ('__all__' IN ($stage_owner) OR i.stage_owner IN ($stage_owner))
  GROUP BY i.asset_id, i.stage, i.stage_entered_at
), curx AS (
  SELECT c.*, extract(epoch FROM now() - c.entered_at)::float8 AS age_s,
         extract(epoch FROM o.objective)::float8 AS obj_s
  FROM cur c
  LEFT JOIN stage_objectives o ON o.stage = c.stage AND o.policy_version = c.policy_version
), top AS (
  SELECT c.stage_owner, c.age_s, c.obj_s FROM curx c ORDER BY c.age_s DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
), s AS (
  SELECT bool_or(lb) AS any_lb FROM curx
)
SELECT now() AS time,
       CASE WHEN s.any_lb THEN 'lower bound, ' || CASE WHEN t.age_s < 86400 THEN 'hours' ELSE 'days' END
                 || ' · ' || coalesce(t.stage_owner, '(no owner)')
            ELSE coalesce(t.stage_owner, '(no owner)') || ' · objective ' || CASE WHEN t.obj_s IS NULL THEN '—' WHEN t.obj_s < 3600 THEN to_char(t.obj_s / 60, 'FM9990') || ' min' WHEN t.obj_s < 86400 THEN to_char(t.obj_s / 3600, 'FM9990.0') || ' h' ELSE to_char(t.obj_s / 86400, 'FM999990.0') || ' d' END
                 || CASE WHEN t.age_s < 86400 THEN ' (hours)' ELSE '' END END AS metric,
       CASE WHEN t.age_s < 86400 THEN t.age_s / 3600 ELSE t.age_s / 86400 END AS value
FROM top t CROSS JOIN s

panels.title: Ledger history
panels.description:
Definition: time since the first engine scan in scan_runs (kind 'engine'). Delivery clocks need history: a completed stage episode or milestone clock can only be measured exactly after the engine has watched it begin and end.
Units: days (hours under 1 day, said in the caption).
Filters: none.
Unknown vs zero: 'No scan yet' when scan_runs has no engine scan.

targets.rawSql:
WITH h AS (
  SELECT extract(epoch FROM now() - min(started_at))::float8 AS s FROM scan_runs WHERE kind = 'engine'
)
SELECT now() AS time,
       'since the first engine scan' || CASE WHEN h.s < 86400 THEN ' (hours)' ELSE '' END AS metric,
       CASE WHEN h.s < 86400 THEN h.s / 3600 ELSE h.s / 86400 END AS value
FROM h

panels.title: Backlog age now, by stage owner
panels.description:
Definition: open stage episodes (servers waiting in a stage), by stage owner in pipeline order and by age (now - stage_entered_at): < 1 d, 1–3 d, 3–7 d, 7–30 d, > 30 d. A server waiting in two stages (e.g. some GPUs missing, others free) appears under both owners.
Units: servers.
Filters: site, stage_owner.
Unknown vs zero: 'Age unknown' (purple) holds episodes whose clock began before observation and whose minimum age is under 30 days, because their true age could fall in any older band; one whose minimum age already exceeds 30 days is in '> 30 d'. 'No ledger data yet' when the ledger has no open interval. Current state = intervals still open in the ledger (ended_at IS NULL), i.e. the latest engine scan; Queues and Evidence show its age.

  FROM capacity_intervals i
  JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id
  WHERE i.ended_at IS NULL AND i.category = 'IDLE' AND i.stage IS NOT NULL
    AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site))
    AND ('__all__' IN ($stage_owner) OR i.stage_owner IN ($stage_owner))
  GROUP BY i.asset_id, i.stage, i.stage_entered_at
), curx AS (
  SELECT c.*, extract(epoch FROM now() - c.entered_at)::float8 AS age_s,
         extract(epoch FROM o.objective)::float8 AS obj_s
  FROM cur c
  LEFT JOIN stage_objectives o ON o.stage = c.stage AND o.policy_version = c.policy_version
), own AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (stage) stage, stage_owner
  FROM capacity_intervals
  WHERE stage IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY stage, started_at DESC, id DESC
), pol AS (
  SELECT policy_version FROM capacity_intervals ORDER BY started_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
), stg(stage, ord) AS (VALUES
  ('PRE_PROVISIONING', 1), ('PROVISIONING', 2), ('GPU_PLATFORM', 3), ('SERVING', 4)
)
SELECT coalesce(o.stage_owner, s.stage) AS "Owner",
       nullif(count(c.asset_id) FILTER (WHERE NOT c.lb AND c.age_s < 86400), 0) AS "< 1 d",
       nullif(count(c.asset_id) FILTER (WHERE NOT c.lb AND c.age_s >= 86400 AND c.age_s < 3 * 86400), 0) AS "1–3 d",
       nullif(count(c.asset_id) FILTER (WHERE NOT c.lb AND c.age_s >= 3 * 86400 AND c.age_s < 7 * 86400), 0) AS "3–7 d",
       nullif(count(c.asset_id) FILTER (WHERE NOT c.lb AND c.age_s >= 7 * 86400 AND c.age_s < 30 * 86400), 0) AS "7–30 d",
       nullif(count(c.asset_id) FILTER (WHERE c.age_s >= 30 * 86400), 0) AS "> 30 d",
       nullif(count(c.asset_id) FILTER (WHERE c.lb AND NOT coalesce(c.age_s >= 30 * 86400, false)), 0) AS "Age unknown (began before observation)"
FROM stg s
LEFT JOIN own o ON o.stage = s.stage
LEFT JOIN curx c ON c.stage = s.stage
WHERE ('__all__' IN ($stage_owner) OR coalesce(o.stage_owner, s.stage) IN ($stage_owner))
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals WHERE ended_at IS NULL)
GROUP BY s.stage, s.ord, o.stage_owner
ORDER BY s.ord

panels.title: Backlog now, by stage owner
panels.description:
Definition: per stage owner (pipeline order), the open stage episodes: servers and idle GPUs waiting, how many are past the stage objective (servers and GPUs: overdue capacity), how many clocks began before observation, the objective of the current policy version, and the median and oldest age.
Units: servers, GPUs, durations (min, h, d).
Filters: site, stage_owner.
Unknown vs zero: '≥' on Median age and Oldest when any clock in that row began before observation (minimum ages). Overdue counts only clocks whose minimum age already passed the objective, so it is a minimum when 'Clock began before observation' is above 0; an empty Overdue cell means some episode's stage has no objective (not 0). 0 servers = nothing waiting in that stage now. Current state = intervals still open in the ledger (ended_at IS NULL), i.e. the latest engine scan; Queues and Evidence show its age.

  FROM cur c
  LEFT JOIN stage_objectives o ON o.stage = c.stage AND o.policy_version = c.policy_version

  FROM capacity_intervals

  ORDER BY stage, started_at DESC, id DESC

), stg(stage, ord) AS (VALUES
  ('PRE_PROVISIONING', 1), ('PROVISIONING', 2), ('GPU_PLATFORM', 3), ('SERVING', 4)
)
SELECT coalesce(o.stage_owner, s.stage) AS "Owner",
       count(c.asset_id) AS "Servers waiting",
       coalesce(sum(c.gpus), 0) AS "GPUs waiting",
       CASE WHEN count(c.asset_id) FILTER (WHERE c.obj_s IS NULL) = 0
            THEN count(c.asset_id) FILTER (WHERE c.age_s > c.obj_s) END AS "Overdue servers",

            THEN coalesce(sum(c.gpus) FILTER (WHERE c.age_s > c.obj_s), 0) END AS "Overdue GPUs",
       count(c.asset_id) FILTER (WHERE c.lb) AS "Clock began before observation",
       CASE WHEN extract(epoch FROM (SELECT x.objective FROM stage_objectives x, pol WHERE x.stage = s.stage AND x.policy_version = pol.policy_version))::float8 IS NULL THEN '—' WHEN extract(epoch FROM (SELECT x.objective FROM stage_objectives x, pol WHERE x.stage = s.stage AND x.policy_version = pol.policy_version))::float8 < 3600 THEN to_char(extract(epoch FROM (SELECT x.objective FROM stage_objectives x, pol WHERE x.stage = s.stage AND x.policy_version = pol.policy_version))::float8 / 60, 'FM9990') || ' min' WHEN extract(epoch FROM (SELECT x.objective FROM stage_objectives x, pol WHERE x.stage = s.stage AND x.policy_version = pol.policy_version))::float8 < 86400 THEN to_char(extract(epoch FROM (SELECT x.objective FROM stage_objectives x, pol WHERE x.stage = s.stage AND x.policy_version = pol.policy_version))::float8 / 3600, 'FM9990.0') || ' h' ELSE to_char(extract(epoch FROM (SELECT x.objective FROM stage_objectives x, pol WHERE x.stage = s.stage AND x.policy_version = pol.policy_version))::float8 / 86400, 'FM999990.0') || ' d' END AS "Objective",

panels.title: Selected period: speed of completed work (last $period complete days vs the $period before)
Verdict: is completed work quicker?
panels.description:
Definition: a deterministic sentence per headline clock, written only when its predicates hold (AGENT.md §13 'Are we getting faster?'):
- 'Not enough history' unless both periods have at least $min_n exact samples.
- 'Quicker' needs p50 shorter and p90 not longer; 'Slower' the reverse; otherwise 'Mixed' or 'No change'.
- 'Quicker:' (green) also needs no overdue or possibly-overdue server in the backlog and no fewer completions than before; otherwise it reads 'Quicker on completed work only' (orange), because completions describe finished work only.
Every sentence ends with the backlog now.
Units: durations, servers.
Filters: site (stage_owner does not apply: both clocks span owners). Window: completions in the last $period complete UTC days before the end of the time range, vs the $period days before that (variable 'Comparison period'). Clocks (ADR-0005): a sample is exact when both ends were observed by the engine; '≥' samples have an exact end and a start that began before observation; samples whose end was not observed (milestone already true at first sight, rework, end unobserved) are never used. Percentiles use exact samples when there are at least $min_n; otherwise exact + '≥' samples give a lower bound shown as '≥'; otherwise 'insufficient history'.
This is a temporal comparison, not a causal claim.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ep AS (
  SELECT i.asset_id, i.stage, i.stage_entered_at AS entered_at,
         bool_or(i.stage_entered_lower_bound) AS entered_lb,
         (array_agg(i.stage_owner ORDER BY i.started_at DESC, i.id DESC))[1] AS stage_owner,
         bool_or(i.ended_at IS NULL) AS is_open,
         max(i.ended_at) AS last_end
  FROM capacity_intervals i
  WHERE i.category = 'IDLE' AND i.stage IS NOT NULL AND i.stage_entered_at IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY i.asset_id, i.stage, i.stage_entered_at
), ms AS (
  SELECT m.asset_id,
         min(m.observed_at) FILTER (WHERE m.milestone = 'in_serverscan') AS reg_at,
         bool_or(NOT m.lower_bound) FILTER (WHERE m.milestone = 'in_serverscan') AS reg_flag,
         min(m.observed_at) FILTER (WHERE m.milestone = 'first_seen') AS seen_at,
         bool_or(NOT m.lower_bound) FILTER (WHERE m.milestone = 'first_seen') AS seen_flag,
         min(m.observed_at) FILTER (WHERE m.milestone = 'gpu_ready') AS ready_at,
         bool_or(NOT m.lower_bound) FILTER (WHERE m.milestone = 'gpu_ready') AS ready_flag,
         min(m.observed_at) FILTER (WHERE m.milestone = 'workload_running') AS work_at,
         bool_or(NOT m.lower_bound) FILTER (WHERE m.milestone = 'workload_running') AS work_flag,
         min(m.observed_at) FILTER (WHERE m.milestone = 'first_genuine_request') AS req_at,
         bool_or(NOT m.lower_bound) FILTER (WHERE m.milestone = 'first_genuine_request') AS req_flag
  FROM milestones m
  GROUP BY m.asset_id
), scan AS (
  SELECT s.started_at, lag(s.status) OVER (ORDER BY s.started_at, s.id) = 'ok' AS prev_ok
  FROM scan_runs s
  WHERE s.kind = 'engine'
), clk0 AS (
  SELECT ms.asset_id, ms.seen_at, ms.ready_at, ms.work_at, ms.req_at, ms.work_flag,
         CASE WHEN ms.reg_at <= coalesce(ms.seen_at, ms.reg_at) THEN ms.reg_at ELSE ms.seen_at END AS rec_at,
         CASE WHEN ms.reg_at <= coalesce(ms.seen_at, ms.reg_at) THEN coalesce(ms.reg_flag, false)
              ELSE coalesce(ms.seen_flag, false) OR coalesce(sc.prev_ok, false) END AS rec_exact,
         coalesce(ms.ready_flag, false) OR EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals p
           WHERE p.asset_id = ms.asset_id AND p.ended_at = ms.ready_at AND p.category = 'IDLE'
             AND p.stage IN ('PRE_PROVISIONING', 'PROVISIONING', 'GPU_PLATFORM')
             AND p.reason_code <> 'GPU_MISSING') AS ready_exact,
         coalesce(ms.req_flag, false) OR (
           EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals p
                   WHERE p.asset_id = ms.asset_id AND p.ended_at = ms.req_at AND p.category = 'IDLE')
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals u
                           WHERE u.asset_id = ms.asset_id AND u.category = 'UNKNOWN'
                             AND u.started_at < ms.req_at
                             AND coalesce(u.ended_at, 'infinity') >= ms.req_at)) AS req_exact
  FROM ms
  LEFT JOIN scan sc ON sc.started_at = ms.seen_at
), clk AS (
  SELECT c.*,
         coalesce(c.work_flag, false) OR c.ready_exact OR coalesce(c.work_at > c.ready_at, false) AS work_exact
  FROM clk0 c
), smp AS (
  SELECT e.stage AS clock, e.stage_owner AS owner, e.asset_id, e.last_end AS done_at,
         extract(epoch FROM e.last_end - e.entered_at)::float8 AS secs,
         CASE WHEN nx.next_rank > array_position(ARRAY['PRE_PROVISIONING', 'PROVISIONING', 'GPU_PLATFORM', 'SERVING']::text[], e.stage)
              THEN CASE WHEN e.entered_lb THEN 'min' ELSE 'exact' END
              ELSE 'other' END AS bound
  FROM ep e
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT max(CASE WHEN n.category = 'PRODUCTIVE' THEN 5
                    WHEN n.category = 'IDLE' THEN array_position(ARRAY['PRE_PROVISIONING', 'PROVISIONING', 'GPU_PLATFORM', 'SERVING']::text[], n.stage) END) AS next_rank
    FROM capacity_intervals n
    WHERE n.asset_id = e.asset_id AND n.started_at = e.last_end
  ) nx
  WHERE NOT e.is_open
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'rec_ready', NULL, c.asset_id, c.ready_at,

panels.title: Time to GPU-ready · p50
panels.description:
Definition: Median (p50) of first record → GPU-ready over clocks that completed in the window, one sample per server. First record = the earliest of the server-scan registration (created_at, exact) and the engine's first sighting (exact only when the engine's previous scan was complete). GPU-ready = the gpu_ready milestone, exact when the ledger shows the transition (a pre-ready DC/Redbull/POPAI interval ended at that scan).
Units: days.
Filters: site (stage_owner does not apply: the clock spans owners). Window: completions in the last $period complete UTC days before the end of the time range, vs the $period days before that (variable 'Comparison period'). Clocks (ADR-0005): a sample is exact when both ends were observed by the engine; '≥' samples have an exact end and a start that began before observation; samples whose end was not observed (milestone already true at first sight, rework, end unobserved) are never used. Percentiles use exact samples when there are at least $min_n; otherwise exact + '≥' samples give a lower bound shown as '≥'; otherwise 'insufficient history'. The caption gives n; 'lower bound' (purple, '≥') means exact + '≥' samples were used. Physical receipt or acceptance dates need procurement input (R3).

WITH ep AS (
  SELECT i.asset_id, i.stage, i.stage_entered_at AS entered_at,
         bool_or(i.stage_entered_lower_bound) AS entered_lb,
         (array_agg(i.stage_owner ORDER BY i.started_at DESC, i.id DESC))[1] AS stage_owner,
         bool_or(i.ended_at IS NULL) AS is_open,
         max(i.ended_at) AS last_end
  FROM capacity_intervals i
  WHERE i.category = 'IDLE' AND i.stage IS NOT NULL AND i.stage_entered_at IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY i.asset_id, i.stage, i.stage_entered_at
), ms AS (
  SELECT m.asset_id,
         min(m.observed_at) FILTER (WHERE m.milestone = 'in_serverscan') AS reg_at,
         bool_or(NOT m.lower_bound) FILTER (WHERE m.milestone = 'in_serverscan') AS reg_flag,
         min(m.observed_at) FILTER (WHERE m.milestone = 'first_seen') AS seen_at,
         bool_or(NOT m.lower_bound) FILTER (WHERE m.milestone = 'first_seen') AS seen_flag,
         min(m.observed_at) FILTER (WHERE m.milestone = 'gpu_ready') AS ready_at,
         bool_or(NOT m.lower_bound) FILTER (WHERE m.milestone = 'gpu_ready') AS ready_flag,
         min(m.observed_at) FILTER (WHERE m.milestone = 'workload_running') AS work_at,
         bool_or(NOT m.lower_bound) FILTER (WHERE m.milestone = 'workload_running') AS work_flag,
         min(m.observed_at) FILTER (WHERE m.milestone = 'first_genuine_request') AS req_at,
         bool_or(NOT m.lower_bound) FILTER (WHERE m.milestone = 'first_genuine_request') AS req_flag
  FROM milestones m
  GROUP BY m.asset_id
), scan AS (
  SELECT s.started_at, lag(s.status) OVER (ORDER BY s.started_at, s.id) = 'ok' AS prev_ok
  FROM scan_runs s
  WHERE s.kind = 'engine'
), clk0 AS (
  SELECT ms.asset_id, ms.seen_at, ms.ready_at, ms.work_at, ms.req_at, ms.work_flag,
         CASE WHEN ms.reg_at <= coalesce(ms.seen_at, ms.reg_at) THEN ms.reg_at ELSE ms.seen_at END AS rec_at,
         CASE WHEN ms.reg_at <= coalesce(ms.seen_at, ms.reg_at) THEN coalesce(ms.reg_flag, false)
              ELSE coalesce(ms.seen_flag, false) OR coalesce(sc.prev_ok, false) END AS rec_exact,
         coalesce(ms.ready_flag, false) OR EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals p
           WHERE p.asset_id = ms.asset_id AND p.ended_at = ms.ready_at AND p.category = 'IDLE'
             AND p.stage IN ('PRE_PROVISIONING', 'PROVISIONING', 'GPU_PLATFORM')
             AND p.reason_code <> 'GPU_MISSING') AS ready_exact,
         coalesce(ms.req_flag, false) OR (
           EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals p
                   WHERE p.asset_id = ms.asset_id AND p.ended_at = ms.req_at AND p.category = 'IDLE')
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals u
                           WHERE u.asset_id = ms.asset_id AND u.category = 'UNKNOWN'
                             AND u.started_at < ms.req_at
                             AND coalesce(u.ended_at, 'infinity') >= ms.req_at)) AS req_exact
  FROM ms
  LEFT JOIN scan sc ON sc.started_at = ms.seen_at
), clk AS (
  SELECT c.*,
         coalesce(c.work_flag, false) OR c.ready_exact OR coalesce(c.work_at > c.ready_at, false) AS work_exact
  FROM clk0 c
), smp AS (
  SELECT e.stage AS clock, e.stage_owner AS owner, e.asset_id, e.last_end AS done_at,
         extract(epoch FROM e.last_end - e.entered_at)::float8 AS secs,
         CASE WHEN nx.next_rank > array_position(ARRAY['PRE_PROVISIONING', 'PROVISIONING', 'GPU_PLATFORM', 'SERVING']::text[], e.stage)
              THEN CASE WHEN e.entered_lb THEN 'min' ELSE 'exact' END
              ELSE 'other' END AS bound
  FROM ep e
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT max(CASE WHEN n.category = 'PRODUCTIVE' THEN 5
                    WHEN n.category = 'IDLE' THEN array_position(ARRAY['PRE_PROVISIONING', 'PROVISIONING', 'GPU_PLATFORM', 'SERVING']::text[], n.stage) END) AS next_rank
    FROM capacity_intervals n
    WHERE n.asset_id = e.asset_id AND n.started_at = e.last_end
  ) nx
  WHERE NOT e.is_open
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'rec_ready', NULL, c.asset_id, c.ready_at,
         greatest(extract(epoch FROM c.ready_at - c.rec_at), 0)::float8,
         CASE WHEN NOT c.ready_exact THEN 'other' WHEN c.rec_exact THEN 'exact' ELSE 'min' END
  FROM clk c WHERE c.ready_at IS NOT NULL AND c.rec_at IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'ready_work', NULL, c.asset_id, greatest(c.work_at, c.ready_at),
         greatest(extract(epoch FROM c.work_at - c.ready_at), 0)::float8,
         CASE WHEN NOT c.work_exact THEN 'other' WHEN c.ready_exact THEN 'exact' ELSE 'min' END
  FROM clk c WHERE c.work_at IS NOT NULL AND c.ready_at IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'work_req', NULL, c.asset_id, greatest(c.req_at, c.work_at),
         greatest(extract(epoch FROM c.req_at - c.work_at), 0)::float8,
         CASE WHEN NOT c.req_exact THEN 'other' WHEN c.work_exact THEN 'exact' ELSE 'min' END
  FROM clk c WHERE c.req_at IS NOT NULL AND c.work_at IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'rec_req', NULL, c.asset_id, c.req_at,
         greatest(extract(epoch FROM c.req_at - c.rec_at), 0)::float8,
         CASE WHEN NOT c.req_exact THEN 'other' WHEN c.rec_exact THEN 'exact' ELSE 'min' END
  FROM clk c WHERE c.req_at IS NOT NULL AND c.rec_at IS NOT NULL
), win AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', $__timeTo()::timestamptz, 'UTC') AS t1, make_interval(days => $period) AS p
), sel AS (
  SELECT s.*, a.gpu_model, coalesce(a.site, '(none)') AS site,
         CASE WHEN s.done_at >= w.t1 - w.p AND s.done_at < w.t1 THEN 'last'
              WHEN s.done_at >= w.t1 - 2 * w.p AND s.done_at < w.t1 - w.p THEN 'prior' END AS win
  FROM smp s
  CROSS JOIN win w
  JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = s.asset_id
  WHERE ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site))
    AND (s.owner IS NULL OR ('__all__' IN ($stage_owner) OR s.owner IN ($stage_owner)))
), g AS (
  SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.bound = 'exact') AS n_x,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.bound = 'min') AS n_min,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.bound = 'other') AS n_other,
         percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.secs) FILTER (WHERE s.bound = 'exact') AS p50_x,
         percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.secs) FILTER (WHERE s.bound = 'exact') AS p90_x,
         percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.secs) FILTER (WHERE s.bound IN ('exact', 'min')) AS p50_b,
         percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.secs) FILTER (WHERE s.bound IN ('exact', 'min')) AS p90_b
  FROM sel s
  WHERE s.clock = 'rec_ready' AND s.win = 'last'
)
SELECT $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS time,
       CASE WHEN g.n_x >= $min_n THEN 'n = ' || g.n_x || ' · last $period d'
            WHEN g.n_x + g.n_min >= $min_n THEN 'lower bound, days · n = ' || g.n_x || ' + ' || g.n_min || ' ≥'

            WHEN g.n_x + g.n_min >= $min_n THEN g.p90_b / 86400 END AS value
FROM g

panels.title: Clocks: last vs prior period (p50, p90, n, change)
panels.description:
Definition: eight clocks kept separate so one team's delay is never attributed to another:
- Milestone clocks per server: first record → GPU-ready → workload running → first genuine request, and end-to-end first record → first genuine request computed from the same server's milestones (never by adding percentiles). Durations below one scan are recorded as 0.
- Stage clocks per stage episode (same asset, stage and stage_entered_at): from stage entry until no GPU of the server waits in that stage any more and the server moved forward (a later stage or PRODUCTIVE). Episodes that went back to an earlier stage (rework), out of scope, UNKNOWN or out of the ledger are excluded and counted in 'excl.'.
Columns: p50/p90 and n per period; Target = the stage objective of the current policy version (milestone clocks have none); Change = last vs prior, e.g. '4.0 d shorter / 33.3% shorter' (AGENT.md §13 #8), % suppressed on a zero baseline, only when both periods have at least $min_n exact samples (otherwise 'Change in p50' says 'insufficient history' and 'Change in p90' shows '—').
n: '12' exact samples; '3 + 9 ≥' exact + lower-bound samples (the percentile is then '≥'); '· needs $min_n' too few; 'excl.' samples not used.
Units: min, h, d.
Filters: site; stage_owner hides other owners' stage rows (milestone rows span owners and stay). Window: completions in the last $period complete UTC days before the end of the time range, vs the $period days before that (variable 'Comparison period'). Clocks (ADR-0005): a sample is exact when both ends were observed by the engine; '≥' samples have an exact end and a start that began before observation; samples whose end was not observed (milestone already true at first sight, rework, end unobserved) are never used. Percentiles use exact samples when there are at least $min_n; otherwise exact + '≥' samples give a lower bound shown as '≥'; otherwise 'insufficient history'.

WITH ep AS (
  SELECT i.asset_id, i.stage, i.stage_entered_at AS entered_at,
         bool_or(i.stage_entered_lower_bound) AS entered_lb,
         (array_agg(i.stage_owner ORDER BY i.started_at DESC, i.id DESC))[1] AS stage_owner,
         bool_or(i.ended_at IS NULL) AS is_open,
         max(i.ended_at) AS last_end
  FROM capacity_intervals i
  WHERE i.category = 'IDLE' AND i.stage IS NOT NULL AND i.stage_entered_at IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY i.asset_id, i.stage, i.stage_entered_at
), ms AS (
  SELECT m.asset_id,
         min(m.observed_at) FILTER (WHERE m.milestone = 'in_serverscan') AS reg_at,
         bool_or(NOT m.lower_bound) FILTER (WHERE m.milestone = 'in_serverscan') AS reg_flag,
         min(m.observed_at) FILTER (WHERE m.milestone = 'first_seen') AS seen_at,
         bool_or(NOT m.lower_bound) FILTER (WHERE m.milestone = 'first_seen') AS seen_flag,
         min(m.observed_at) FILTER (WHERE m.milestone = 'gpu_ready') AS ready_at,
         bool_or(NOT m.lower_bound) FILTER (WHERE m.milestone = 'gpu_ready') AS ready_flag,
         min(m.observed_at) FILTER (WHERE m.milestone = 'workload_running') AS work_at,
         bool_or(NOT m.lower_bound) FILTER (WHERE m.milestone = 'workload_running') AS work_flag,
         min(m.observed_at) FILTER (WHERE m.milestone = 'first_genuine_request') AS req_at,
         bool_or(NOT m.lower_bound) FILTER (WHERE m.milestone = 'first_genuine_request') AS req_flag
  FROM milestones m
  GROUP BY m.asset_id
), scan AS (
  SELECT s.started_at, lag(s.status) OVER (ORDER BY s.started_at, s.id) = 'ok' AS prev_ok
  FROM scan_runs s
  WHERE s.kind = 'engine'
), clk0 AS (
  SELECT ms.asset_id, ms.seen_at, ms.ready_at, ms.work_at, ms.req_at, ms.work_flag,
         CASE WHEN ms.reg_at <= coalesce(ms.seen_at, ms.reg_at) THEN ms.reg_at ELSE ms.seen_at END AS rec_at,
         CASE WHEN ms.reg_at <= coalesce(ms.seen_at, ms.reg_at) THEN coalesce(ms.reg_flag, false)
              ELSE coalesce(ms.seen_flag, false) OR coalesce(sc.prev_ok, false) END AS rec_exact,
         coalesce(ms.ready_flag, false) OR EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals p
           WHERE p.asset_id = ms.asset_id AND p.ended_at = ms.ready_at AND p.category = 'IDLE'
             AND p.stage IN ('PRE_PROVISIONING', 'PROVISIONING', 'GPU_PLATFORM')
             AND p.reason_code <> 'GPU_MISSING') AS ready_exact,
         coalesce(ms.req_flag, false) OR (
           EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals p
                   WHERE p.asset_id = ms.asset_id AND p.ended_at = ms.req_at AND p.category = 'IDLE')
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals u
                           WHERE u.asset_id = ms.asset_id AND u.category = 'UNKNOWN'
                             AND u.started_at < ms.req_at
                             AND coalesce(u.ended_at, 'infinity') >= ms.req_at)) AS req_exact
  FROM ms
  LEFT JOIN scan sc ON sc.started_at = ms.seen_at
), clk AS (
  SELECT c.*,
         coalesce(c.work_flag, false) OR c.ready_exact OR coalesce(c.work_at > c.ready_at, false) AS work_exact
  FROM clk0 c
), smp AS (
  SELECT e.stage AS clock, e.stage_owner AS owner, e.asset_id, e.last_end AS done_at,
         extract(epoch FROM e.last_end - e.entered_at)::float8 AS secs,
         CASE WHEN nx.next_rank > array_position(ARRAY['PRE_PROVISIONING', 'PROVISIONING', 'GPU_PLATFORM', 'SERVING']::text[], e.stage)
              THEN CASE WHEN e.entered_lb THEN 'min' ELSE 'exact' END
              ELSE 'other' END AS bound
  FROM ep e
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT max(CASE WHEN n.category = 'PRODUCTIVE' THEN 5
                    WHEN n.category = 'IDLE' THEN array_position(ARRAY['PRE_PROVISIONING', 'PROVISIONING', 'GPU_PLATFORM', 'SERVING']::text[], n.stage) END) AS next_rank
    FROM capacity_intervals n
    WHERE n.asset_id = e.asset_id AND n.started_at = e.last_end
  ) nx
  WHERE NOT e.is_open
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'rec_ready', NULL, c.asset_id, c.ready_at,
         greatest(extract(epoch FROM c.ready_at - c.rec_at), 0)::float8,
         CASE WHEN NOT c.ready_exact THEN 'other' WHEN c.rec_exact THEN 'exact' ELSE 'min' END
  FROM clk c WHERE c.ready_at IS NOT NULL AND c.rec_at IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'ready_work', NULL, c.asset_id, greatest(c.work_at, c.ready_at),
         greatest(extract(epoch FROM c.work_at - c.ready_at), 0)::float8,
         CASE WHEN NOT c.work_exact THEN 'other' WHEN c.ready_exact THEN 'exact' ELSE 'min' END
  FROM clk c WHERE c.work_at IS NOT NULL AND c.ready_at IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'work_req', NULL, c.asset_id, greatest(c.req_at, c.work_at),
         greatest(extract(epoch FROM c.req_at - c.work_at), 0)::float8,
         CASE WHEN NOT c.req_exact THEN 'other' WHEN c.work_exact THEN 'exact' ELSE 'min' END
  FROM clk c WHERE c.req_at IS NOT NULL AND c.work_at IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'rec_req', NULL, c.asset_id, c.req_at,
         greatest(extract(epoch FROM c.req_at - c.rec_at), 0)::float8,
         CASE WHEN NOT c.req_exact THEN 'other' WHEN c.rec_exact THEN 'exact' ELSE 'min' END
  FROM clk c WHERE c.req_at IS NOT NULL AND c.rec_at IS NOT NULL
), win AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', $__timeTo()::timestamptz, 'UTC') AS t1, make_interval(days => $period) AS p
), sel AS (
  SELECT s.*, a.gpu_model, coalesce(a.site, '(none)') AS site,
         CASE WHEN s.done_at >= w.t1 - w.p AND s.done_at < w.t1 THEN 'last'
              WHEN s.done_at >= w.t1 - 2 * w.p AND s.done_at < w.t1 - w.p THEN 'prior' END AS win
  FROM smp s

), clocks(clock, label, ord, stage) AS (VALUES
  ('rec_ready', 'First record → GPU-ready', 1, NULL),
  ('ready_work', 'GPU-ready → workload running', 2, NULL),
  ('work_req', 'Workload → first genuine request', 3, NULL),
  ('rec_req', 'End-to-end: record → first request', 4, NULL),
  ('PRE_PROVISIONING', 'DC stage (pre-provisioning)', 5, 'PRE_PROVISIONING'),
  ('PROVISIONING', 'Redbull stage (provisioning)', 6, 'PROVISIONING'),
  ('GPU_PLATFORM', 'POPAI stage (GPU platform)', 7, 'GPU_PLATFORM'),
  ('SERVING', 'Serving stage (until productive)', 8, 'SERVING')
), g AS (
  SELECT s.clock, s.win, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.bound = 'exact') AS n_x,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.bound = 'min') AS n_min,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.bound = 'other') AS n_other,
         percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.secs) FILTER (WHERE s.bound = 'exact') AS p50_x,
         percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.secs) FILTER (WHERE s.bound = 'exact') AS p90_x,
         percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.secs) FILTER (WHERE s.bound IN ('exact', 'min')) AS p50_b,
         percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.secs) FILTER (WHERE s.bound IN ('exact', 'min')) AS p90_b
  FROM sel s
  WHERE s.win IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY s.clock, s.win
)

       CASE WHEN coalesce(l.n_x, 0) >= $min_n AND coalesce(p.n_x, 0) >= $min_n THEN CASE WHEN l.p90_x = p.p90_x THEN 'no change' WHEN p.p90_x <= 0 THEN CASE WHEN abs(l.p90_x - p.p90_x) IS NULL THEN '—' WHEN abs(l.p90_x - p.p90_x) < 3600 THEN to_char(abs(l.p90_x - p.p90_x) / 60, 'FM9990') || ' min' WHEN abs(l.p90_x - p.p90_x) < 86400 THEN to_char(abs(l.p90_x - p.p90_x) / 3600, 'FM9990.0') || ' h' ELSE to_char(abs(l.p90_x - p.p90_x) / 86400, 'FM999990.0') || ' d' END || ' ' || CASE WHEN l.p90_x < p.p90_x THEN 'shorter' ELSE 'longer' END || ' (no %: zero baseline)' ELSE CASE WHEN abs(l.p90_x - p.p90_x) IS NULL THEN '—' WHEN abs(l.p90_x - p.p90_x) < 3600 THEN to_char(abs(l.p90_x - p.p90_x) / 60, 'FM9990') || ' min' WHEN abs(l.p90_x - p.p90_x) < 86400 THEN to_char(abs(l.p90_x - p.p90_x) / 3600, 'FM9990.0') || ' h' ELSE to_char(abs(l.p90_x - p.p90_x) / 86400, 'FM999990.0') || ' d' END || ' ' || CASE WHEN l.p90_x < p.p90_x THEN 'shorter' ELSE 'longer' END || ' / ' || to_char(100 * abs(l.p90_x - p.p90_x) / p.p90_x, 'FM99990.0') || '% ' || CASE WHEN l.p90_x < p.p90_x THEN 'shorter' ELSE 'longer' END END ELSE '—' END AS "Change in p90"
FROM clocks k
LEFT JOIN own o ON o.stage = k.stage
LEFT JOIN g l ON l.clock = k.clock AND l.win = 'last'
LEFT JOIN g p ON p.clock = k.clock AND p.win = 'prior'
WHERE k.stage IS NULL OR ('__all__' IN ($stage_owner) OR o.stage_owner IN ($stage_owner))
ORDER BY k.ord

Definition: per UTC week in the time range, eligible servers (ever IDLE or PRODUCTIVE in the ledger) whose first record fell in that week, that became GPU-ready, and that received their first genuine request. panels.title: Selected period: intake cohorts and strata
Intake cohorts: share reaching GPU-ready and first genuine request by age
panels.description:
Definition: servers whose first record (exact) falls in the time range, grouped by UTC intake week. Denominators: Eligible = ever IDLE or PRODUCTIVE in the ledger; Out of scope = only ever NOT_CHARGED (other intended use, outside target clusters); Never classified = only ever UNKNOWN. Cells: share of Eligible that reached the milestone within 1, 7, 14 or 30 days of first record, with the count, e.g. '62% (5/8)'.
Units: % of eligible servers.
Filters: site, time range (stage_owner does not apply).
Unknown vs zero: 'not matured' = the youngest server in the cohort is not that old yet (never shown as a failure). Reached = the milestone was recorded by that age (a milestone first seen later may have happened earlier, so it is not counted as reached). Not reached = at that age the ledger held the server only in IDLE or PRODUCTIVE intervals and the milestone came later or not at all. Otherwise (the engine was not watching yet, or the server was UNKNOWN or out of scope then) its state is unknown and it counts as not reached, so the share is a minimum: '≥' (purple); 'unobserved' = no server's state is known; '—' = no eligible server. Paused or cancelled servers are not distinguished in R1 (no action ledger yet). Servers whose first record is only a lower bound have no intake week and are not listed. First genuine request is serving demand; servers used only by Run:ai training never record one.

  FROM ep e
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT max(CASE WHEN n.category = 'PRODUCTIVE' THEN 5
                    WHEN n.category = 'IDLE' THEN array_position(ARRAY['PRE_PROVISIONING', 'PROVISIONING', 'GPU_PLATFORM', 'SERVING']::text[], n.stage) END) AS next_rank
    FROM capacity_intervals n
    WHERE n.asset_id = e.asset_id AND n.started_at = e.last_end
  ) nx
  WHERE NOT e.is_open
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'rec_ready', NULL, c.asset_id, c.ready_at,
         greatest(extract(epoch FROM c.ready_at - c.rec_at), 0)::float8,
         CASE WHEN NOT c.ready_exact THEN 'other' WHEN c.rec_exact THEN 'exact' ELSE 'min' END
  FROM clk c WHERE c.ready_at IS NOT NULL AND c.rec_at IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'ready_work', NULL, c.asset_id, greatest(c.work_at, c.ready_at),
         greatest(extract(epoch FROM c.work_at - c.ready_at), 0)::float8,
         CASE WHEN NOT c.work_exact THEN 'other' WHEN c.ready_exact THEN 'exact' ELSE 'min' END
  FROM clk c WHERE c.work_at IS NOT NULL AND c.ready_at IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'work_req', NULL, c.asset_id, greatest(c.req_at, c.work_at),
         greatest(extract(epoch FROM c.req_at - c.work_at), 0)::float8,
         CASE WHEN NOT c.req_exact THEN 'other' WHEN c.work_exact THEN 'exact' ELSE 'min' END
  FROM clk c WHERE c.req_at IS NOT NULL AND c.work_at IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'rec_req', NULL, c.asset_id, c.req_at,
         greatest(extract(epoch FROM c.req_at - c.rec_at), 0)::float8,
         CASE WHEN NOT c.req_exact THEN 'other' WHEN c.rec_exact THEN 'exact' ELSE 'min' END
  FROM clk c WHERE c.req_at IS NOT NULL AND c.rec_at IS NOT NULL
), win AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', $__timeTo()::timestamptz, 'UTC') AS t1, make_interval(days => $period) AS p
), sel AS (
  SELECT s.*, a.gpu_model, coalesce(a.site, '(none)') AS site,
         CASE WHEN s.done_at >= w.t1 - w.p AND s.done_at < w.t1 THEN 'last'
              WHEN s.done_at >= w.t1 - 2 * w.p AND s.done_at < w.t1 - w.p THEN 'prior' END AS win
  FROM smp s
  CROSS JOIN win w
  JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = s.asset_id
  WHERE ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site))
    AND (s.owner IS NULL OR ('__all__' IN ($stage_owner) OR s.owner IN ($stage_owner)))
), g AS (
  SELECT coalesce(s.gpu_model, '(unknown model)') AS gpu_model, s.site, s.win, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.bound = 'exact') AS n_x,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.bound = 'min') AS n_min,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.bound = 'other') AS n_other,
         percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.secs) FILTER (WHERE s.bound = 'exact') AS p50_x,
         percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.secs) FILTER (WHERE s.bound = 'exact') AS p90_x,
         percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.secs) FILTER (WHERE s.bound IN ('exact', 'min')) AS p50_b,
         percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.secs) FILTER (WHERE s.bound IN ('exact', 'min')) AS p90_b
  FROM sel s
  WHERE s.clock = '$clock' AND s.win IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
), keys AS (
  SELECT gpu_model, site, sum(n_x + n_min + n_other) AS total FROM g GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT k.gpu_model AS "GPU model",
       k.site AS "Site",
       CASE WHEN coalesce(l.n_x, 0) >= $min_n THEN CASE WHEN l.p50_x IS NULL THEN '—' WHEN l.p50_x < 3600 THEN to_char(l.p50_x / 60, 'FM9990') || ' min' WHEN l.p50_x < 86400 THEN to_char(l.p50_x / 3600, 'FM9990.0') || ' h' ELSE to_char(l.p50_x / 86400, 'FM999990.0') || ' d' END WHEN coalesce(l.n_x, 0) + coalesce(l.n_min, 0) >= $min_n THEN '≥ ' || CASE WHEN l.p50_b IS NULL THEN '—' WHEN l.p50_b < 3600 THEN to_char(l.p50_b / 60, 'FM9990') || ' min' WHEN l.p50_b < 86400 THEN to_char(l.p50_b / 3600, 'FM9990.0') || ' h' ELSE to_char(l.p50_b / 86400, 'FM999990.0') || ' d' END ELSE '—' END AS "p50 · last $period d",
       CASE WHEN coalesce(l.n_x, 0) >= $min_n THEN coalesce(l.n_x, 0)::text || CASE WHEN coalesce(l.n_min, 0) + coalesce(l.n_other, 0) > 0 THEN ' · ' || (coalesce(l.n_min, 0) + coalesce(l.n_other, 0)) || ' excl.' ELSE '' END WHEN coalesce(l.n_x, 0) + coalesce(l.n_min, 0) >= $min_n THEN coalesce(l.n_x, 0) || ' + ' || coalesce(l.n_min, 0) || ' ≥' || CASE WHEN coalesce(l.n_other, 0) > 0 THEN ' · ' || coalesce(l.n_other, 0) || ' excl.' ELSE '' END ELSE (coalesce(l.n_x, 0) + coalesce(l.n_min, 0)) || ' · needs $min_n' || CASE WHEN coalesce(l.n_other, 0) > 0 THEN ' · ' || coalesce(l.n_other, 0) || ' excl.' ELSE '' END END AS "n · last $period d",
       CASE WHEN coalesce(p.n_x, 0) >= $min_n THEN CASE WHEN p.p50_x IS NULL THEN '—' WHEN p.p50_x < 3600 THEN to_char(p.p50_x / 60, 'FM9990') || ' min' WHEN p.p50_x < 86400 THEN to_char(p.p50_x / 3600, 'FM9990.0') || ' h' ELSE to_char(p.p50_x / 86400, 'FM999990.0') || ' d' END WHEN coalesce(p.n_x, 0) + coalesce(p.n_min, 0) >= $min_n THEN '≥ ' || CASE WHEN p.p50_b IS NULL THEN '—' WHEN p.p50_b < 3600 THEN to_char(p.p50_b / 60, 'FM9990') || ' min' WHEN p.p50_b < 86400 THEN to_char(p.p50_b / 3600, 'FM9990.0') || ' h' ELSE to_char(p.p50_b / 86400, 'FM999990.0') || ' d' END ELSE '—' END AS "p50 · prior $period d",
       CASE WHEN coalesce(p.n_x, 0) >= $min_n THEN coalesce(p.n_x, 0)::text || CASE WHEN coalesce(p.n_min, 0) + coalesce(p.n_other, 0) > 0 THEN ' · ' || (coalesce(p.n_min, 0) + coalesce(p.n_other, 0)) || ' excl.' ELSE '' END WHEN coalesce(p.n_x, 0) + coalesce(p.n_min, 0) >= $min_n THEN coalesce(p.n_x, 0) || ' + ' || coalesce(p.n_min, 0) || ' ≥' || CASE WHEN coalesce(p.n_other, 0) > 0 THEN ' · ' || coalesce(p.n_other, 0) || ' excl.' ELSE '' END ELSE (coalesce(p.n_x, 0) + coalesce(p.n_min, 0)) || ' · needs $min_n' || CASE WHEN coalesce(p.n_other, 0) > 0 THEN ' · ' || coalesce(p.n_other, 0) || ' excl.' ELSE '' END END AS "n · prior $period d",
       CASE WHEN coalesce(l.n_x, 0) >= $min_n AND coalesce(p.n_x, 0) >= $min_n THEN CASE WHEN l.p50_x = p.p50_x THEN 'no change' WHEN p.p50_x <= 0 THEN CASE WHEN abs(l.p50_x - p.p50_x) IS NULL THEN '—' WHEN abs(l.p50_x - p.p50_x) < 3600 THEN to_char(abs(l.p50_x - p.p50_x) / 60, 'FM9990') || ' min' WHEN abs(l.p50_x - p.p50_x) < 86400 THEN to_char(abs(l.p50_x - p.p50_x) / 3600, 'FM9990.0') || ' h' ELSE to_char(abs(l.p50_x - p.p50_x) / 86400, 'FM999990.0') || ' d' END || ' ' || CASE WHEN l.p50_x < p.p50_x THEN 'shorter' ELSE 'longer' END || ' (no %: zero baseline)' ELSE CASE WHEN abs(l.p50_x - p.p50_x) IS NULL THEN '—' WHEN abs(l.p50_x - p.p50_x) < 3600 THEN to_char(abs(l.p50_x - p.p50_x) / 60, 'FM9990') || ' min' WHEN abs(l.p50_x - p.p50_x) < 86400 THEN to_char(abs(l.p50_x - p.p50_x) / 3600, 'FM9990.0') || ' h' ELSE to_char(abs(l.p50_x - p.p50_x) / 86400, 'FM999990.0') || ' d' END || ' ' || CASE WHEN l.p50_x < p.p50_x THEN 'shorter' ELSE 'longer' END || ' / ' || to_char(100 * abs(l.p50_x - p.p50_x) / p.p50_x, 'FM99990.0') || '% ' || CASE WHEN l.p50_x < p.p50_x THEN 'shorter' ELSE 'longer' END END ELSE 'insufficient history (n = ' || coalesce(l.n_x, 0) || ' vs ' || coalesce(p.n_x, 0) || ')' END AS "Change in p50"
FROM keys k
LEFT JOIN g l ON l.gpu_model = k.gpu_model AND l.site = k.site AND l.win = 'last'
LEFT JOIN g p ON p.gpu_model = k.gpu_model AND p.site = k.site AND p.win = 'prior'
ORDER BY k.total DESC, k.gpu_model, k.site
LIMIT 20

options.content:
**Not built yet (Release 2). This panel never shows a number.**

- **What is missing:** per period and stage owner, arrivals into and completions out of each stage, cancellations, rework (returns to an earlier stage), work in progress over time and net change; and a burn-down scenario (backlog ÷ positive net completions) only when the queue is stable and completions exceed arrivals.
- **Where it would come from:** stage entries and exits are already in the ledger (`capacity_intervals` stage episodes); cancellations, rework reasons and intervention dates need the R2 action and commitment ledger (§13 "Action ranking"); a forecast needs several weeks of stable history.
- **Onboarding step:** R2 adds the backlog-flow view over the ledger's stage episodes and imports the action ledger; no new collector is needed.
- **Until then:** backlog now and its age are in the first row of this page, weekly arrivals and completions in "Volume per week", and current queues on the Queues page (E03).
